description: Customer can register and log in (JWT, hashed password); role is always CUSTOMER
steps: GET /auth/me with token returns the user

description: Role-based access: customers cannot use /officer routes; officers cannot use customer routes
Customer can create, edit (DRAFT only) and submit a credit card application
Credit Officer can approve (with limit) or reject (with comment) a pending application exactly once
steps: Approve creates ISSUED card with approved limit and application CARD_ISSUED
Reject requires a comment and creates no card

description: Customer can activate an ISSUED card; ACTIVE cards cannot be re-activated
steps: POST /cards/:id/activate sets ACTIVE + activatedAt and application CARD_ACTIVATED

description: Customer can request a limit increase/decrease on an ACTIVE card; all requests need Credit Team approval
steps: POST /cards/:id/limit-requests returns PENDING with derived type

description: Credit Officer can approve/reject limit requests; approval updates creditLimit and availableLimit
steps: Approve updates card limit and shifts availableLimit by the delta
Reject leaves the card unchanged and stores the comment

description: Every business event writes an AuditLog row with actor, entity, action, timestamp, comment
steps: The nine audit actions are recorded across the full lifecycle

description: Customers can only access their own applications, cards and limit requests (404 otherwise)
steps: Customer A GET/PATCH/submit/activate/limit-request on B's resources returns 404 with no data

description: Customer portal: dashboard, new application, application status, card details/activation, limit management, history
steps: Playwright: register, apply, see PENDING CREDIT REVIEW
Activate card and request a limit change from the UI

description: Credit Officer portal: dashboard, pending applications, review/approve/reject, limit requests, decision history
steps: Playwright: officer approves and rejects; history shows the decisions

description: Security hardening: CORS allow-list, helmet headers, login lockout, JWT HS256 only, stored role wins over token claim
steps: Disallowed Origin gets no Access-Control-Allow-Origin header
